gaps.sentence: Millions suffer ___ hay fever every summer.
Were you aware ___ the change of plan?
Can I borrow a pen ___ you?
Several parents objected ___ the new timetable.
She has a good relationship ___ her students.
gaps.explanation: a relationship WITH somebody (BETWEEN two parties).

gaps.sentence: Have you paid ___ the tickets yet?
gaps.explanation: pay FOR goods/services; pay a bill (no preposition).

gaps.sentence: It never occurred ___ me to check the address.
gaps.explanation: it occurred TO somebody = they thought of it.

gaps.sentence: Staff must always be polite ___ customers.
